title: Opening possibilities
description: Two lightly hinged planes and a line passing through them suggest opening a new possibility, with the blue field left mostly uninterrupted.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE original wide 16:9 editorial illustration, high resolution, not a webpage, mockup or card. The supplied screenshot is a STYLE AND SCALE reference only: notice its small crafted conceptual drawings, very thin lightly irregular ink line and large uninterrupted flat color fields. Do not reproduce any existing icon, hand arrangement, screenshot layout, typography, card borders, UI or article text. Draw the new subject described below.
Composition system: a SMALL centered conceptual illustration occupying about 26 percent of canvas width and 30 percent of canvas height. Keep the entire drawing inside the central region. The rest is empty space: at least 80–90 percent uninterrupted flat single-color field. No decorative corner marks, baseline, surrounding scatter or extraneous patterns. Slight asymmetry within the tiny drawing gives life.
Drawing voice: delicate confident editorial pen line, lightly irregular but precise, around 1.5–2 pixels thick at 1200px image width (roughly 2–3px at 1672px), NOT thick cartoon outline or UI icon. Use very few lines and only one or two small solid shapes. A considered handmade drawing with large spaces between its strokes. Absolutely flat opaque fills, no shading or depth rendering.
STRICT: no embedded text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, captions, photos, 3D, shadows, highlights, gradient, glow, grain, fabric texture or paper texture across the background. No musical gear, documents, magnifying glasses, checkmarks, robot, brain or arrows. No heavy outlines. No background object or framed illustration panel. Background must be a perfectly uniform solid hex color corner-to-corner.
Background: a perfectly FLAT uniform hero blue #0565BB covering the entire landscape canvas.
Ink: fine deep-forest #132B26. Solid fills: warm off-white #F6F6EC.
New original subject: a tiny open hinged structure made of TWO simple off-white planes, slightly splayed around a delicate shared hinge. They are abstract planes, not a book, document, door icon or architectural rendering. No perspective shading; their opening is communicated just by gentle angular outlines and two flat ivory shapes. One very fine curving forest line passes through the opening and continues a short distance on either side, a simple loose curve with no arrowhead. Arrange the structure close to center, a touch right, and keep the whole drawing small, approximately 26 percent width by 30 percent height. It should feel like an original, spare editorial ink sketch on an enormous calm field of blue.
